title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
description: I’m a qualified counsellor and practicing visual artist. As a sculptor, I experiment with materials and processes. Often, I find myself working something over repeatedly; I add a layer of something and then partially strip it back, and then I add something else and do the same.

name: Dana Kabaila
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
description: Dana (she/her) is a lived-experience neurodivergent counsellor and narrative therapist based in Naarm/Melbourne. Dana has experience supporting client's exploring: gender expansiveness, sexuality and neuro-queer identity childhood, familial and trans-generational trauma chronic illness, fatigue and/or pain meltdowns, shut downs, burn out and recovery substance use suicidal thoughts (sometimes described as singing your death song) Narrative Therapy training grounds Dana's work in a First Nation's social justice framework. She has specialised training in Persistent Drive for Autonomy (previously Pathological Demand Avoidance), Rejection Sensitivity Dysphoria, Situational Non-speaking (clinically labelled Selective Mutism), restricted diet and mealtime difficulties, and trans and gender expansive voice identity coaching. Dana's experience working with children contributes to a nurturing approach to the young parts held in the stories of adults.
specialties: LGBTIQA+, Sex Therapy, Transgender affirming care, Trauma

name: Daniel Gray
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 1)
description: Hi there, I'm Daniel, a registered counsellor offering counselling services in Brisbane, Melbourne and online. I apply a non-judgemental, person-centred counselling style to create a safe, confidential space for people to speak freely and explore their concerns. My areas of expertise are gender and sexuality affirming care, addiction, and integrating psychedelic and altered state experiences.

name: Daniela Petrovic
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 4)
description: ​At Soul Village Therapy, I work with sensitive, deep-feeling individuals to address chronic stress, anxiety, depression, self esteem and relationship issues. I draw from Focusing-oriented therapy, somatic experiencing, and trauma-informed and relational attachment theory to provide an integrative approach. I'm especially attuned to how trauma lives in the body and how to bring the nervous system back to equilibrium - creating inner-harmony.
